abstract: (131)Iodine ((131)I) labelled antibody directed against human chorionic gonadatrophin (hCG) was given on 21 occasions to 18 patients with hCG-producing neoplasms. Tumours were localized by external scintigraphy in 13 of 21 investigations. Positive results were obtained reliably when serum hCG exceeded 500 miu/ml and in some cases sensitivity was comparable to that of computerized tomography. A positive result probably implies viability in the tumour and this was of practical value in discriminating between necrotic deposits and living tumour before surgery.
abstract_ja: ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)に対する131I標識抗体を、hCG産生腫瘍の18例に計21回投与した。外部シンチグラフィにより、21回中13回で腫瘍を局在化できた。血清hCGが500 mIU/mLを超えた場合に信頼性の高い陽性結果が得られ、症例によってはコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)と同等の感度を示した。陽性所見は腫瘍の生存を示唆しており、手術前に壊死性病変と生存腫瘍を鑑別するうえで実用的な価値があった。
